digest.component_or_area: ticket store / optimistic concurrency / description field
propositions: A verified description write (14,997 chars) was silently reverted to a stale earlier revision (10,582 chars) while the ticket's own plan-review was in-flight, with no error or conflict signal reported.
Optimistic concurrency protection (ConcurrencyError/exit 10) did not fire on the losing write; the write reported success and passed read-back verification before being silently overwritten.

A whole-description EDIT event carrying stale client-held text can silently overwrite newer content via last-writer-wins reduction, because current optimistic concurrency only covers state-dependent operations.
Read-back verification after a successful edit is insufficient protection; stale text was verified as landed but later replaced by an even stale revision without any error or conflict exception.
